video_title: Jrue Holiday Media Availability | Oct. 19, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the team's execution of coaching schemes
quotes.excerpt: we're running them the way that he asks us to.
quotes.quote: We're running them the way that he asks us to. That's probably the easiest way to go about it.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says the team is focused on running schemes exactly how the coach asks them to. He notes that is the easiest way to go about it.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the team's balance of fun and seriousness
quotes.excerpt: I think they just have fun with the game, but at the same time very serious.
quotes.quote: I think they just have fun with the game, but at the same time very serious. I think we kind of take on the personality of our coach, which he'll laugh with you, but he'll also mother-f you. So, I think when it comes to the plays, it's the same thing where he has some cool-looking plays, but if you execute them right, they're very serious in their work.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday on the team identity under their coach: He will laugh with you but he will also mother-f you. He says the team takes on the personality of their coach.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the importance of unselfish play
quotes.excerpt: I think it builds trust. I think it builds camaraderie.
quotes.quote: I think it builds trust. I think it builds camaraderie. Everybody gets to touch the ball and feel like they're a part of it, and even if you're not shooting it, sometimes just touching the ball for a couple dribbles means something. So just knowing that that person next to you is looking up, looking ahead, trying to make the right play to you, and you kind of have the same mentality, I feel like there's definitely a trust factor.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday believes unselfish play builds trust and camaraderie. He says even just touching the ball for a couple of dribbles means something to players.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the team's character and trust
quotes.excerpt: I think a lot of it is characteristics too. The type of character and people that we have.
quotes.quote: I think a lot of it is characteristics too. The type of character and people that we have. I think we're all very trusting and want to see the person next to us succeed, so I think that translates to the court.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday credits the team character for their on-court success, noting that everyone on the roster wants to see the person next to them succeed.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson's development and contract status
quotes.excerpt: I definitely lean on him, especially being on the same team a lot of training camp.
quotes.quote: I definitely lean on him, especially being on the same team a lot of training camp. Putting a lot of things in his hands, him making the decision, him coming down running plays, and him making the right plays if it's scoring for him or for somebody else, and he's shown out all training camp.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday is impressed with Scoot Henderson during training camp, saying he has been putting a lot of things in his hands and that Henderson has shown out.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson's contract decision
quotes.excerpt: I think Scoot knows that he can control what he can control.
quotes.quote: I think everybody kind of goes through it. If he had questions for me, I'd answer, but for the most part, I think Scoot knows that he can control what he can control. And from there, which is the basketball stuff, the effort, what he puts in, how he performs on the court, and from there he kind of leaves everything else to everything else.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson handling contract questions: He knows he can control what he can control, which is the basketball stuff, the effort, and how he performs on the court.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the benefits of shorter rotation stints
quotes.excerpt: I think the minutes are split up and you can have maybe shorter bursts where you have a lot more energy.
quotes.quote: I think the minutes are split up and you can have maybe shorter bursts where you have a lot more energy and you don't get as tired, as well as just I think it builds trust throughout the team. Knowing that you're going to have 10 or 11 guys that are going to play, we have depth, and I think that's something that we should use if we have it.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says the team plans to utilize their depth with shorter rotation stints, noting that playing 10 or 11 guys helps maintain energy levels.

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the team's focus on rebounding
quotes.excerpt: It's been brought up a lot that last year our defensive rebound was terrible, but offensive rebounding was good.
quotes.quote: It's been brought up a lot that last year our defensive rebound was terrible, but offensive rebounding was good. And for us to be a really good team, defensively and offensively, we have to rebound. So that conversation is brought up every day.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says defensive rebounding is a daily point of emphasis for the team after it was a struggle last season. He notes that for them to be a really good team they have to rebound.
